The code builds the command as: executable + " \"" + url + "\"" (line 14), then passes it to std::system (line 16). No validation or sanitization is performed on the url. If url contains a double quote ("), the quoting is broken, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary shell commands. For example, on Linux a url like http://example.com/"; rm -rf / would result in the shell executing the injected rm command. Thus the source to sink path is unprotected and a concrete exploit exists.
